main_body: Nightstand: a wide light-orange tabletop slab over a narrower drawer body with a gold handle, on two legs with an open gap between them
top_band: light orange, rows 17-20 (about 4 rows), with dark brown outline on row 16 above it
evidence: In the middle column, dark outline sits at row 16. Rows 17-20 are a light orange top band with a lighter-to-mid gradient. Row 21 is mid-orange slab front, and row 22 is dark brown, reading as the eave shadow. Rows 23-26 are the drawer face with an inset-looking panel and handle, and rows 27-30 are legs with an open gap. The 4-row top is a real horizontal surface, comparable to the guide's 'seat: top 5 + legs'. There is no distinct front-edge highlight line, but the tone step plus the shadow and set-back body are enough for a 3/4 read.

style.evidence: The outline is dark brown and tinted, which is correct. The material ramps are shallow: about 3-4 browns/oranges, with a few grain dots on the top. The drawer face and legs are flat brown fills at 5x5 pixels or larger. Next to the stall and well references, which have many tones and per-stone or per-board texture, tiles here carry only about 3-5 colours. It looks thinner and flatter than the reference.
